subject: Re: Kickoff: worst-case recall — resourcing + Corpus deadline
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Umar leads methodology and the repro (the codebase branches from our logit_adjustment release, which he knows well); Carmen runs the internal-workload validation; Paloma does the trainer integration and data plumbing.

Compute — light. CIFAR-10/100 long-tail runs are single-node jobs; the internal workload needs a few dozen A100s at peak. Titan best-effort throughout, no reservation, no discretionary budget ask.

On your Corpus note: confirmed with Jun's team — the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10. Our window closes 06-29, but the internal workload's long-tail tfrecords must be re-registered under the v2 schema before that freeze or the Q3 retraining pipeline inherits a broken path. Paloma is doing the re-registration in early June alongside the validation work, so we're clear of the deadline with margin rather than discovering it in July.

Deshawn
